items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal Interview, 1962-05-24
items.q: And my mother had this race horse. I'll never forget. Diamond they called him.

ctx.x: And the people would come out to buy the meat. You see? And so, um, uh, what do I want to say about this? So I kept this bell all these many years. And every new year, we get this bell out and ring. Go all around the house, ring this bell. So this year, he was in California for New Year's. So my little granddaughter was here and my grandson. And oh, they all pushed each other. Where is the bell? Where is the bell? Let me ring the bell. And so finally, we have two bells. I think they found the other, but they…
From where you all went to? To Thibodeau, you remember?
